title: TAI activation neutral event gate
objective: Ensure every activation event creates a verifiable authority job, while unrelated issue comments and unsuccessful workflow_run events exit neutrally without target outputs or false production status; exact owner activation remains fail-closed.
boundaries: The upstream authority job is always materialized for supported workflow events
Unrelated issue comments and non-success/non-main workflow_run events exit with no target SHA output
Only /tai activate current-main on issue 3365 by the repository owner can resolve a preflight run
The exact successful owner preflight and all six required jobs remain mandatory
Image, protected controller, RU/EN/ZH SSE, Chromium, finalization, rollback and standalone deployment gates are unchanged
